project_info.theme: Papeda and ikan kuah kuning ingredient story
project_info.color_palette: Sago cream, turmeric yellow, leaf green, ceramic beige, lime green, chili red

main_subject.detail: A ceramic bowl of Papeda with vivid yellow fish broth sits at the bottom; a long elastic ribbon of translucent sago rises to a wooden fork above it.
main_subject.style: Hyperreal food photography with frozen splash motion and clean educational ingredient labels

composition_elements.text: Papeda & Ikan Kuah Kuning; Sagu (Papeda); Ikan Tongkol; Kuah Kuning; Daun Kemangi; Cabe Merah; Jeruk Nipis
items: Top: oversized white dish title over blurred tropical foliage.
Center: a wooden fork pulls a glossy vertical sago strand above the bowl.
Around the sago: floating fish pieces, yellow broth splash, basil, red chili slices, and lime wedges.
Sides: thin white leader lines with Indonesian ingredient labels.
Bottom: tactile speckled ceramic bowl on a banana-leaf-covered surface.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Soft natural daylight with studio fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glossy broth, translucent sago, wet ingredient detail, shallow tropical background blur, frozen splash energy

prompt_instructions: Attach a recipe-accurate food reference before rendering.
Keep Indonesian dish and ingredient wording exactly after native-language review.
Use final typesetting for reliable labels.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic cinematic food photography of a traditional Indonesian dish, presented as a floating ingredients infographic. The finished dish sits at the bottom in a ceramic bowl on a wooden surface. Above it, key ingredients float in mid-air in a clean vertical layout, each clearly separated and visually balanced. Thin minimalist pointer lines connect ingredients to elegant readable labels. Natural textures, hyper-detailed food surfaces, glossy sauces, steam rising gently, high-speed splash effects frozen in motion. Soft studio lighting mixed with natural daylight, shallow depth of field, premium editorial food poster style, commercial advertising quality, ultra-sharp focus, 8K resolution, realistic shadows, clean background.
prompt.negative_prompt: inauthentic ingredients, broken sago strand, muddy broth, unreadable labels, messy splashes, artificial food texture, low resolution, watermark, signature
